parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable or disable web tamper proofing for the specified server. Valid values:

*   **on**: enables web tamper proofing
*   **off**: disables web tamper proofing

> After you disable web tamper proofing for the specified server, one quota is released.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the server for which you want to enable or disable web tamper proofing. You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to query the UUIDs of servers.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-web-lock-status --source-ip 125.71.XX.XX --lang zh --uuid inet-12345670000 --status on --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyWebLockStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status on --SourceIp '125.71.XX.XX' --Uuid 'inet-12345670000' --Lang zh
